+def test_live_stderr_messages(qtbot, proc, py_proc, message_mock, caplog):
+    """Stderr output is reported before its process exits."""
+    proc._output_messages = True
+    cmd, args = py_proc("""
+        import sys, time
+        print('first', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        time.sleep(0.5)
+        print('second', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+    """)
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        proc.start(cmd, args)
+        qtbot.waitUntil(lambda: bool(message_mock.messages), timeout=5000)
+        assert proc.outcome.running
+        assert message_mock.messages[0].level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
+        assert message_mock.messages[0].text == 'first'
+        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=5000):
+            pass
+
+    assert [msg.text for msg in message_mock.messages] == [
+        'first', 'first\nsecond', 'first\nsecond']
+
